original.title: The scalar victim gate is exactly a support-exchange inequality
assumptions: Canonical positive-MEX/COPY recurrence and the named banked lemmas in the source.

exactAuditedStatement: For every mortal a, with p=sigma_a, P=predeath p-service hosts, V={h<a:sigma_h<=a+1}, S=P intersect V and M={h<a:sigma_h>a+1, h not in P}, A(p)+A(a+1)-a=|S|-|M|+1[p=a+1]. In particular the indicator vanishes when p>a+1.
hypotheses: Positive blocker count; sigma=infinity for immortal columns.
The original simple r equality requires p>a+1, automatic if C_a nonempty.
proofDependencyMap: Shared canonical foundation: exact positive-MEX/COPY recurrence and P01-P12, independently reconstructed in ../CANONICAL-FOUNDATIONS.md with exact declaration mapping and game interpretation. DEPENDENCIES.json records the additional service lemmas. Final kernel receipts bind the source versions.
independentDerivationAndChecks: P is inside the a older columns. Blockers t<=a have victims<a. Among blockers<=a+1 the sole possible victim outside that universe is a itself at death a+1, occurring iff p=a+1. Thus |V|=A(a+1)-1[p=a+1].
Inside the a-element universe, complement(P union V)=M and intersection(P, V)=S. Inclusion-exclusion gives |P|+|V|=a-|M|+|S|; substitute counts.
Exact literal initial witness: rows[1],[2,3],[3,2,4], a1, p2, P{0}, V/S/M empty. Then K=1 while |S|-|M|=0. This refutes the unguarded displayed catalogue identity.

The source itself states p>a+1 where needed; the publication summary dropped that quantifier. The repair preserves the original C-case gate without proving its nonnegative sign. Under X=W empty, early-dead P hostsS empty and a C host lies in M; a nonnegative gate would contradict C, but that gate remains open.
